title: review-queue coord-roles.json config
description: Schema for tools/review-queue/coord-roles.json — the per-role-per-event-type SLA config consumed by src/coord/roles.ts at daemon boot. The `headless: true` discriminant requires `invoke_command` (an argv-vector NOT a shell string, per 057a r4 codex F2 HIGH — defense-in-depth against shell injection; 057b uses argv-spawn). IDE-mode roles MUST set `headless: false` and MAY omit `invoke_command`. The cross-field constraint `max_deadline_sec > default_deadline_sec` is NOT expressible in draft-07 if/then; it is enforced in the TypeScript loader.

invoke_command.description: Argv vector (not a shell string). Templated values {{WT}} (worktree absolute path) and {{PROMPT}} (prompt file path) are substituted as array elements by 057b's invoker. Required when headless=true.
